story.text: i got to stay...
h.y!
hey!
hello?
who are you?
hows it going.
you are way to doom and gloom.
i dont understand.
you imagine things that arent happening.
so much of what you are experiencing isn't happening.
you think to much.
i didnt know i was such a lucid dreamer?
you dont know much when you drink that much.
awh come on it was a joke...
are you the one who keeps responding to me?
huh? ow no. That's all you.
like i said, you think to much. all those thoughts are you talking to your self.
just like now funny enough.
like now?
well i wanted to give you some advice.
you could have just talked.
socialized with your coworkers.
you already switched jobs to be more social. yet nothing changed.
the only difference now is that you can drink on the job. which is not an improvement.
you only fueled your own sleeplessness not to mention your substance abuse problems.
also you keep working yourself to the bone. you are working twice as hard as the rest for what?
so they dont get mad at you?
come on?
i try to better myself i really do.
like when you tried to stay sober?
i... i sometimes just loose control.
i dont know how to explain it.
it just gives me this ease of mi...
SHIT!!!
i fell asleep!
now i need to walk home...
the end station is not that far from my house.
its still very cold outside. but the nature is nice.
brings my mind at ease.
everything is still woozy. i can still feel the alcohol.
the night is soothing...
i romanticize the solitude a bit to much.
but the park is so quiet, makes me forget my troubles for just a moment.
and the fresh air smells amazing.
sometimes i wish i was the only one on this earth.
ah i am already here.
finally home..
i just wanna lay down and sleep.
i dont have the strength to change into my pajamas
right now i just want to sleep.
the bed feels so cozy.
today was horrible.
Lets see if tomorrow is any better.
